notes.title: Quality of Life
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added pro tips in the options menu to help out.
[*] Items are indestructible for longer after spawn.
[*] The item blast damage radius is bigger to reach more enemies.
[*] Radar lasts longer.
[*] Radar markers on the screen edges stays visible longer.
[*] Fixed some text.
[*] Updated some enemy sprites.
[*] Gave new players more time to read the tutorial text (but it’s all in the pro tips now anyway).
[*] Fixed wrong camera screen ratio on some config.
[*] Added a way to tip me.
[*] Added links to my other games, check them out ✌️
[/list]

notes.title: Calibration Round
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Smoother difficulty balance between waves.
[*] Items are easier to pick up (reduced odds of them exploding at spawn time).
[*] Reviewed item spawning balance across waves.
[*] Reviewed and adjusted some item prices/availability in the shop.
[*] Added key bindings for keyboard to enhance touchpad compatibility. Use (A & D) or (arrow keys) + (space) to swap.
[*] Reviewed and improved some FX (rocket trails, railgun ...)
[*] Added an alarm sound for when enemies deploy nuclear weapons.
[*] Fixed window mode settings not being saved.
[*] Fixed resolution settings not being saved.
[*] Fixed issue where city destruction was not visible.
[*] Fixed text overflow issues where some text did not fit on the screen.
[*] Fixed the bombing lighting effect not displaying in the menu background when the game loses focus.
[/list]
✌️
